window 1 (0x20e101000, Apple's name AICTimerRegs) is the ADT node aic-timebase (reg 0x0e101000, size 0x1000). The AppleInterruptController kext (text 0x68ca000-0x68cc4f8) makes no access in the 0x1000-0x1fff range, so on iOS the timebase is brought up outside the kernel (iBoot or hardware).
